scope: Observed local compiler, generated native programs, trusted-template fixtures, fuzzing, grammar and packaging; desktop acceptance is recorded separately
clippy: all targets, fuzzing feature, -D warnings passed
msrv: Rust 1.74.0 locked offline all-target check passed

cases_per_compiler: copied/shared/exclusive collection traversal and recoverable extraction
interface dispatch and inline enum traversal/extraction
contact search, phone filtering, confirmed/cancelled batch removal and Unicode save/reload
EOF at batch confirmation preserves the in-memory book
v8_generated_native_smoke.instrumentation: The EOF scenario adds a read-only post-loop observer to a throwaway source copy; ordinary application scenarios use the shipped source unchanged

traversal_allocation_probe.scope: Actual generated copied/shared/exclusive and empty-loop code with an instrumented integer-output checkpoint observing the memory counter

trusted_template_fixture.scope: Exact shipped C templates instantiated by Python, not a substitute for generated-program verification

fuzz.scope: Real bounded campaigns with isolated seed copies; not a general safety proof

publication_policy: No workstation paths, process IDs, session-local artifact references, private evidence locations, caches, profiles or credentials
